title: An efficient mixed-integer linear programming formulation for solving influence diagrams
summary: Influence diagrams represent decision-making problems with interdependencies between random events, decisions, and consequences. Traditionally, they have been solved using tailored algorithms that determine the expected utility-maximizing decision strategy. Towards this end, most recent state-of-the-art solution approaches convert them into mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) models that can be solved using off-the-shelf MILP solvers.
